observations.behavior: Adds a new optional parameter and its corresponding response field to the workflows list query.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the MCP workflow tool to request workflow results ordered by the completion time of the newest run, rather than the workflow creation time. This could help users prioritize workflows with recent activity or completed runs, potentially improving workflow discovery and relevance for end-users interacting with PostHog's workflow execution capabilities.
